item.title: Record number of drivers expected for holiday season
item.description: AAA is projecting over 100 million people to travel for the holidays, with nearly 90% of those drivers taking road trips, and gas prices are trending down to a nationwide average of under $4, while Missouri's average is around $2.50 a gallon.

item.title: Trading Snow for Sunshine: Ozarks Heat Shatters December Records
item.description: Well, I’m sure some people are upset that we won’t be getting a white Christmas this year. But if you ask me, sunny skies and 70-degree temperatures are the next best thing. item.title: Springfield stores see strong last‑minute holiday sales as shoppers navigate economic pressures
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — With Christmas just days away, last‑minute shoppers are packing Springfield stores, and local businesses say this year’s economy is playing a major role in how much people are spending. item.description: CAMDEN COUNTY, Mo. — The Missouri Department of Conservation (MDC) is alerting residents around Missouri to the opportunity of donating their live Christmas tree after the holiday. item.title: Student loan borrowers in default to face wage garnishments next year
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — Student loan borrowers in default will soon face wage garnishment starting next year. This comes after the Trump administration's rollback of a COVID-era pause on payments. When borrowers fail to make payments for nine months, their loans become defaulted, allowing the government to seize approximately 15% of their income to repay the [...]

item.title: Robbery suspect arrested for stealing chicken in Rolla
item.description: A man was arrested in Rolla, Missouri after stealing two bags of chicken from a store and threatening the manager with a knife, before being apprehended by a truck driver and police.

item.title: Last week’s Springfield restaurant health code violations, Dec. 15-19
item.description: 26 restaurants in Springfield were found to have health code violations related to food safety and sanitation during the week of Dec. 15-19.

item.title: Fans and lawmakers react to Chiefs moving to Kansas
item.description: MISSOURI — The Kansas City Chiefs announced today they will relocate to Kansas by 2031 following an agreement with state lawmakers to fund a new domed stadium. item.title: Springfield restaurants that will be open on Christmas Day
item.description: Black Sheep Burgers & Shakes is giving away free burgers from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. at their downtown location, and many other restaurants in the Springfield area are open and ready to serve for the holidays.
